name: How long does a typical garage renovation project take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical garage renovation project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most garage renovations take between one and three weeks, depending on the scope of work. Simple drywall installation, taping, and interior painting can take five to seven business days, factoring in required drying times for joint compound and primer. If your project involves custom partition framing, extensive trim carpentry, or coordinated electrical installations for heavy shop machinery, timelines extend to two or three weeks. Unforeseen moisture repairs on older wall studs or concrete interfaces can also alter the expected schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard garage renovation takes about one to three weeks, depending on framing complexity, drywall drying times, and electrical rough-ins.
